name: Respiratory Viral DREAM Challenge (leaderboard)
description: Leaderboard reporting best-performing model scores for the Respiratory Viral DREAM Challenge, measuring predictive performance on challenge tasks related to respiratory viruses.
evaluation_method: AUROC (primary) and Spearman correlation for some tasks
general_score_metric: AUROC (area under the ROC curve); some subtasks report Spearman correlation or other task-specific metrics
reputation: Moderately well-regarded within the systems-biology / DREAM challenge community as a meaningful open challenge for predictive models of host response to respiratory viruses.
notes: Multiple heterogeneous tasks with modest sample sizes; results are task-dependent and some subtasks use different metrics; potential for cohort-specific biases and data heterogeneity; non-LLM, gene-expression / clinical-type predictive benchmark.
